### September 2026 — The lab begins at NTU!

The Cham QMagSpin Lab launches in the School of Electrical and Electronic Engineering at Nanyang Technological University.

### September 2026 — We are recruiting!

We welcome enquiries from prospective PhD students, postdoctoral researchers, and undergraduate researchers interested in quantum materials, magnonics, spintronics, and ultrafast spectroscopy.
